name: Kravel's Crate
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard has a crate to send to the Nesingwary expedition in Stranglethorn Vale. It holds specialized ammunition for hunting the jungle’s deadliest game.

sections.title: A Delivery to the Jungle
sections.body: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard hands the crate to travelers. A wealthy dwarven patron ordered it weeks ago, but the shipment was delayed until the buyer had left Kalimdor. The patron had paid for forwarding, and Kravel wants to keep the favor of a wealthy customer. So he trusts passing travelers to carry it across continents to northern Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Special-Gauge Ammunition
sections.body: Salt dust gathers on the crate as it waits in the Shimmering Flats. Inside are heavy, special-gauge rounds made for hunting rifles. The travelers deliver them to the expedition camp north of Grom'gol. The recipient says big-game hunters prize the potent ammunition. Against the predators roaming the jungle canopy, it is vital for survival.

faq.answer: Kravel's Crate holds heavy, special-gauge ammunition for hunting rifles. Big-game hunters use it against dangerous beasts in the wild.
Kravel Koalbeard sent the crate. He is a dwarven merchant at the Mirage Raceway, amid the racing and gambling of the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Where does this crate need to go?
faq.answer: The crate is bound for the Nesingwary hunting expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale. The camp lies along the river north of Grom'gol Base Camp.

aliases: why did kravel take so long
faq.answer: The parcel took weeks to reach the Thousand Needles salt flats. By then, the customer had packed up and left for the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale.

angles.text: As a hunter, you find specialized heavy ammunition in the crate. It is made for high-end dwarven hunting rifles and big-game expeditions.
As a dwarf, you see Kravel Koalbeard's business in the salt flats linked to the renowned Nesingwary hunting party in the Eastern Kingdoms.
